name: Geode bit
description: a small floating half of a broken black slag geode, jagged edge glowing with molten orange lava, one small furious glowing eye

poses.stand: floating in the air, the glowing broken edge facing forward
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers twitchily, its broken edge glowing

move.action: darts forward to the right, trailing sparks, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, centered in the frame with plenty of empty space around it, the whole thing visible. One thing alone, nothing else: no body, no arms, no legs, no person. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is this thing. Show the exact same thing {action}. Keep everything about it the same as image 1: shape, colors, size and position in the frame and art style. {background}
